# Pretense

> Real code protection for AI coding tools. Pretense sits between source code and
> the AI tools that read it, so secrets, SSNs and card numbers are always mutated before any request reaches a third-party model. Email addresses and phone numbers are mutated under every framework profile except PCI, and anywhere they are labeled.

## Documentation

- [Quickstart](https://www.pretense.ai/docs/quickstart): Install Pretense and route your first AI tool through it, in 4 commands.
- [AI coding tools](https://www.pretense.ai/docs/ai-tools): Guard AI CLIs. Secrets, SSNs and card numbers are always mutated. Email and phone numbers are mutated when labeled and under every framework profile except PCI.
- [How it works](https://www.pretense.ai/docs/how-it-works): How it works: Secrets, SSNs and card numbers are always mutated. Email and phone numbers are mutated when labeled and under every framework profile except PCI.
- [Configuration](https://www.pretense.ai/docs/config): 1 file and a handful of environment variables. Everything has a working default.
- [CLI reference](https://www.pretense.ai/docs/cli): Every command the shipped binary accepts and what it returns.
- [Air-gap](https://www.pretense.ai/docs/air-gap): Run entirely on your own hardware, with local runners and a licence gate that fails closed.
- [Automation & CI](https://www.pretense.ai/docs/automation): Catch secrets before they are committed and again before they are merged.
- [API & clients](https://www.pretense.ai/docs/api): Point any OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible client at Pretense by changing 1 base URL.
- [Code graph](https://www.pretense.ai/docs/code-graph): A local graph of the functions, classes and constants in your repo. It records each identifier on your machine. The renaming happens in the proxy.
- [Full documentation text](https://www.pretense.ai/llms-full.txt): The text of every documentation page in one file, generated from the rendered pages.

## Key facts

- Secrets, SSNs and card numbers are always mutated. Email addresses and phone numbers are mutated under every framework profile except PCI (SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, ISO 27001, CMMC L2, NIST), and anywhere they are labeled. Mutated secrets and PII are never put back into the model's reply, so a model cannot echo them into a link or output.
- To mutate unlabeled email addresses and phone numbers, run pretense start --framework <profile> with any profile except PCI. Without a profile, or under PCI, unlabeled email addresses and phone numbers leave the machine as written.
- Code identifiers are renamed on the way out and restored byte-exactly in the reply. An identifier inside the model's thinking block stays a stand-in, because that signed block passes through unchanged.
- The CLI wraps Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini and Aider: pretense run <tool>.
- Pretense is not SOC 2 or HIPAA certified today.
- Plans: Free, Startup and Enterprise. Current prices are on the pricing page.

## Install

Install the CLI with:

    curl -fsSL https://www.pretense.ai/install.sh | sh

## Uninstall

Remove the CLI with:

    curl -fsSL https://www.pretense.ai/uninstall.sh | sh
